name: MarketAux
tagline: Financial news API with sentiment analysis for market intelligence
description: MarketAux is a financial news API that aggregates real-time market news from thousands of sources, with built-in entity recognition, sentiment scoring, and filtering by stock symbols, industries, and countries. Designed for developers building trading apps, portfolio tools, and market research platforms who need structured news data with sentiment signals.

auth.details: API key via token query parameter (token=YOUR_API_KEY), self-serve signup

pricing.paid_plans: Starter, Professional, Business tiers with higher limits — see marketaux.com/pricing

rate_limits: 100 requests/day on free tier; higher limits on paid plans
use_cases: fetch latest financial news for a stock ticker
get market news with sentiment scores for portfolio monitoring
filter news by industry, country, or entity type
build a market sentiment dashboard from multi-source headlines
aggregate real-time company news for trading signals
